title: Count the cash
summary: Write down what is actually in a cash box or an account, and the record keeps it as a balance check and writes the difference from what it thought was there into the ledger.
changes: An account that holds a cleared entry in another currency since it was last stated is no longer compared. The count is kept and says so under What happened, and no balance check and no difference are written, where before the entry was left out and a difference equal to it could be filed. An account whose entries are all in one currency is counted as before.
